claim_ceiling: WebArena-Verified v2 shopping does NOT provide a cross-site mechanism-sharing testbed: exactly one shopping store exists (single Magento 'One Stop Market' view, single container am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb, 192 tasks over 49 templates, zero per-store identifiers). Frozen cross-store overlap fraction is vacuous (null), not 0.0, so FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for cross-site specificity is not triggerable. Documentation-level M1=1.0 (12 stores) is falsified for the available verified dataset; it is a WebArena v1 property not present in v2. What IS demonstrated on v2 shopping: high within-store parameterized task family reuse (dup 0.9479, but only 0.0781 exact copies; 91.8% of reuse is parameterized variation), parameterization prevalence 0.8958 task / 0.8367 template, positive control search mechanism present in all sampled AX trees, and 5/5 intent-template to element mapping valid. Thus a within-store parameterized inheritance design (train on some tasks of a family, test on held-out tasks of same family, single store) is viable and parameterized slots exist, but cross-site (train on N stores, test on held-out stores) is impossible on this dataset. No LLM agent inheritance was tested. Ceiling does not extend to v1 multi-store images (auth-blocked), Mind2Web, below-fold or post-checkout flows, or any claim that mechanisms are store-specific.
